verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at developers.llamaindex.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes LlamaParse as a parsing platform for agents. The docs include a dedicated 'for-agents' section and a docs MCP server (search_docs, grep_docs, read_doc), with a ready-made `claude mcp add` command for pointing an agent at the docs. Missing for 10: per-page markdown versions of the docs (the .md probe returned 404), and no independent corroboration of how well agents actually use these resources.
